references.title: Employment Act 1955 (Act 265)
references.quote: An advance of wages may be recovered from wages only as the Act permits: s.22 governs advances to employees and s.24(2) the recoveries an employer may make. The recovery is the approved repayment amount; the approved-purpose list is this employer's policy for advances above one month's wages.
